title: Kickoff: Enterprise Security Enablement Kit v2 (FAQ v2 + one-pagers + RFP library)
creator: Naomi Feldman
description:
## Context
Late-stage security reviews are taking too long and answers are inconsistent across Sales, SE, and Security/GRC. We need a refreshed, standardized enterprise security enablement kit that is accurate across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private, and easy to package/share.

## Goals
- Reduce back-and-forth in security review + procurement by providing a consistent, approved "first response" package.
- Standardize language across Confluence, Drive PDFs, RFP library, and email attachments (no conflicting statements).
- Clearly separate responsibilities + boundaries for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
- Ensure claims are reviewable/auditable (owner, last-reviewed date, version history, approval trail).

## Deliverables (customer-facing unless noted)
1) Security FAQ v2
- Confluence canonical page + exported PDF for field sharing.
- Covers: deployment modes + shared responsibility, encryption, key management options, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, vuln mgmt, incident response/notification (contract-dependent), support SLAs.

2) Compliance + security one-pagers pack
- Confluence canonical pages + consolidated PDF pack.
- Minimum set for v2:
  - SOC 2 posture / evidence access process (high-level; details gated)
  - Encryption (in transit/at rest) + key management (KMS/HSM options where applicable)
  - SSO/SAML (+ SCIM if applicable) + RBAC model overview
  - Audit logging overview + export options (SIEM)
  - Data residency overview (by region + deployment mode)
  - Data retention controls + deletion process

3) Standardized RFP response library
- Confluence canonical library (approved language + variants by deployment mode).
- Includes: evidence pointers + "where to find it" mapping.
- Guardrails for when to route to Security/GRC vs Legal (avoid over-committing).

4) Internal-only: evidence pointer index (restricted)
- Index of where to find SOC 2 letter/report access process, pen test summaries, subprocessor list, audit log schemas, etc.
- NOTE: not shared with customers directly; used by GRC/SEs to respond quickly and consistently.

## Out of scope
- New product/security feature work beyond minor documentation clarifications.
- Legal contract template rewrites (handled via Finance/Legal process when needed).

## Timeline (6 weeks)
Week 1
- Kickoff + inventory existing FAQ/one-pagers/RFP templates.
- Assign source-of-truth owners and define review rubric + versioning.

Weeks 2-3
- Draft updates in Drive.
- Resolve controversial items: retention/residency defaults, audit log scope, Private deployment boundary, incident notification wording.

Week 4
- Formal review cycle (Security Eng + GRC + Product + SE).
- Redlines + approval.
- Map evidence links (SOC 2 access process, pen test summary location, security contact).

Week 5
- Publish canonical Confluence pages.
- Generate field-ready PDFs.
- Update docs-site snippets/links where external references are needed.

Week 6
- Rollout enablement (Sales training notes, Slack announcements).
- RevOps linking (HubSpot/CRM).
- Maintenance plan (quarterly review + update triggers).

## Review + approval workflow (proposed)
1) Drafting in Drive (tracked edits)
- Writers/SMEs iterate; keep an "Open Questions" section per doc.

2) SME accuracy pass (Security Eng + Product owners)
- Validate "what we do today" vs roadmap.
- Remove/qualify absolutes ("always/never") and ensure mode-specific boundaries.

3) GRC/Compliance pass
- Ensure statements align with SOC 2 scope, evidence-sharing constraints, and compliance posture.

4) Solutions Eng field-readability pass
- Ensure answers match common customer questions and are usable in live calls.

5) Final approval + publish
- Confluence becomes canonical.
- PDF export stamped with version + last-reviewed.
- Any restricted material is clearly labeled and access-controlled.

## Packaging + distribution
- Canonical: Confluence pages (latest version).
- Field packaging: Drive PDFs (for sending under NDA when needed).
- CRM: single "Latest Security Kit" link(s) in HubSpot/CRM record templates.

## Acceptance criteria
- FAQ v2 + one-pagers + RFP library published in Confluence with owner + last-reviewed date.
- PDF exports created with consistent template + version stamp.
- Clear Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private responsibility boundary in each relevant answer.
- Evidence-sharing process is documented (internal) and does not leak restricted artifacts.
- Sales/SEs have a single place to grab the latest package and know what can be shared when.

## Risks / known tricky areas
- Data retention defaults vary by deployment mode; must be precise.
- Data residency questions (EU) require careful wording and should avoid implying guarantees beyond configured regions.
- Audit log scope: must match current product behavior and name categories without over-claiming.
- Incident notification: must remain contract-dependent; avoid committing to timelines in enablement docs.
